subject: Security intake: SIG vs custom form + evidence priority
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@helioshealth.com>, Peter Lowe <p.lowe@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + SIG vs custom path / evidence asks

Hi Amira / Peter — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary (2-line): Great first look at Helios' use of Redwood for note-generation + anonymized analytics. Primary red lines for you were HIPAA coverage and proof of SOC 2 in-flight.

Open / proposed next steps:
- Decision path: Would you prefer we start with the standard SIG/CAIQ prefill (fastest) or build a short custom questionnaire focused on HIPAA + PHI scoping? Either works — SIG gives the fastest artifact map.
- Evidence asks: I attached a SIG starter spreadsheet with the high-priority artifacts we typically surface. To prioritize, please confirm: SOC 2 Type II expected date, PHI processing systems, and whether you need a BAA now or later.
- Timeline: If SIG prefill is acceptable, we can send a starter set today and have an internal evidence pull within 3 business days. Custom form will add ~2-4 business days.

Clarifying questions for Helios (please reply inline):
1) SOC 2 status: Is it in progress, and if so what's the expected test-completion month?
2) Data residency: Any stricter than US (e.g., specific state residency requirements)?
3) PHI scope: Which Helios products/systems will ingest PHI from Redwood?
4) Contracting: Who is the procurement/contact for contract redlines (name + email)?

Attachments: SIG-starter.xlsx (starter mapping), sample evidence index.

Thanks — if you want, we can block 30 minutes tomorrow to walk the SIG starter together.

— Jordan

Subject: Re: Quick recap + SIG vs custom path / evidence asks

Thanks Jordan — good summary. A few quick answers inline: 

> 1) SOC 2 status: Is it in progress, and if so what's the expected test-completion month?
SOC 2 Type II is in progress; expected auditor test completion is end of Q4 (Dec 2026). We can share the interim ISMS evidence now (policies, control owners) but not the final report until January.

> 2) Data residency: Any stricter than US (e.g., specific state residency requirements)?
No state-level restriction — US only is fine for now.

> 3) PHI scope: Which Helios products/systems will ingest PHI from Redwood?
Primarily the CareNotes ingestion pipeline (internal project codename CNX) and a small analytics bucket used for de-identified research. CNX will send structured notes and some identifiers initially, so HIPAA-compliant handling is required.

> 4) Contracting: Who is the procurement/contact for contract redlines (name + email)?
Procurement: Peter Lowe (cc'd). He'll coordinate PO and legal.

SIG vs custom: We prefer you start with the SIG prefill so we can get checklist coverage quickly, but we will need a HIPAA appendix (custom) mapped back to SIG rows.

We can do a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT if that works.

— Amira

Posting a short internal note after Amira's reply. Recommended path: start SIG prefill immediately; produce a 1-page HIPAA appendix that maps to SIG rows (we've done this pattern before).

Proposed owners:
- Soojin: can you draft a network diagram and brief encryption summary (at-rest + in-transit)? They'll want specifics for CNX and analytics buckets.
- Kimberly: can you pull available SOC 2 artifacts we can share (policies, control-owner list, recent audit evidence)? We can mark final report as pending.

Target: send SIG starter + network diagram to Amira by EOD tomorrow if possible; Kimberly to confirm which artifacts are shareable vs audit-restricted.

Thanks — I'll run the walkthrough with them tomorrow morning if we have the attachments ready.

— Jordan

Attachment stubs:

2) BAA requirement: Do you need a signed BAA before we start ingesting PHI, or is it acceptable to proceed with a pilot under NDA while the BAA is negotiated?

- Today (EOD): Jordan to send SIG starter + diagram (done).
- Tomorrow (10:00am PT): 30-min walkthrough to align owners and evidence buckets.
- Within 3 business days after walkthrough: Redwood provides evidence index and draft HIPAA appendix.

If the SIG prefill + HIPAA appendix approach works for you, we'll proceed down that path. Otherwise we can pause and convert the SIG into a custom form — that will add ~2 business days.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

— Jordan
